chunk.content: The FAO identification sheet for the leaftail croaker (Johnius trachycephalus) lists similar croakers in the same area, including Johnius dussumieri, J. coitor, J. belangerii, J. carutta and J. hypostomus; J. dussumieri can be told apart by the barbel on its chin.
chunk.source_quote: DISTINGUISHING CHARACTERS OF SIMILAR SPECIES OCCURRING IN THE AREA: Johnius dussumieri: barbel present on chin.

source.title: FAO Species Identification Sheets, Fishing Areas 57 and 71: Sciaenidae, Johnius trachycephalus (SCIAEN John 5)
